findings.title: Clarify the scope of 巴’s sound comparison in the learner card
findings.details: The learner component card says that 巴 bā and 吧 ba form a Mandarin reading comparison, but does not make explicit enough that this supports the sentence-final particle only. The overview also introduces 酒吧, whose 吧 is a separate whole-character loan use with no established sound basis. Clarify that distinction in the card using the cited evidence.
findings.verification: Confirm the updated card explicitly limits the 巴–吧 reading comparison to the particle and states that it does not explain the 酒吧 use; check its citations support both the reading pair and the separate loan use.
